items.t: Worn cylinder head valve seats
items.job: Replace cylinder head with updated GM head
items.note: Includes head gasket set. If the catalytic converter was damaged by misfires, expect more.

items.t: 4L60-E automatic loses 3rd and 4th gear
items.job: Rebuild or replace 4L60-E automatic transmission
items.note: Priced as a rebuild or remanufactured unit. A used transmission costs less but carries more risk.

items.t: Blower fan quits or only works on some speeds
items.job: Replace blower motor and blower motor resistor
items.note: Sometimes only the resistor is needed, which costs less. Replace both if the motor draws high current.

items.t: EVAP leak check engine light
items.job: Smoke-test EVAP system and replace vent or purge valve
items.note: A new gas cap alone may fix it. A cracked charcoal canister costs more.

items.t: Sudden loss of power steering assist (recall)
items.job: Replace steering gear torque sensor cover (recall repair)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Driver front airbag may deploy improperly (recall)
items.job: Replace driver front airbag module
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: 8-speed automatic shudder
items.job: Transmission fluid flush with updated GM fluid (TSB 18-NA-355)
items.note: If the torque converter is already damaged it must be replaced, which costs much more.

items.t: Diesel warnings and no-starts from chafed engine wiring
items.job: Inspect and repair chafed diesel engine wiring harness
items.note: If the harness section is badly damaged and must be replaced, expect more.

items.t: DEF fault on cold starts (emissions recall)
items.job: Reprogram engine control software (recall)
items.note: Free under GM emissions recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Turbo engine wiring chafes on hot parts
items.job: Inspect and repair engine wiring harness near the turbo
items.note: Often covered by the factory warranty on these model years. Ask the dealer.

items.t: Radiator hose quick-connect coolant leaks
items.job: Replace leaking radiator hose and quick-connect fitting
items.note: GM special coverage may pay for this. Check your VIN or ask the dealer. Overheating damage costs much more.

items.t: Ticking from the top of the engine
items.job: Replace soft valve lash adjusters and rocker arms
items.note: Usually covered by the powertrain warranty on these model years. Ask the dealer.

items.t: Automatic emergency braking activates for no reason (recall)
items.job: Update front camera module software (recall)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Front wheel hub bolts may loosen or break (recall)
items.job: Replace front wheel hub bolts on both sides (recall)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN. If the hub is damaged, it may also need replacing.

items.t: Fuel pump lock ring not fully secured (recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure fuel pump lock ring (recall)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Front brake calipers may leak fluid (recall 15V-278)
items.job: Replace front brake calipers and bleed brakes
items.note: Free under recall 15V-278. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat frame hooks may not be attached (recall 15V-267)
items.job: Inspect and correct front seat installation
items.note: Free under recall 15V-267. Check the VIN first.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump may come loose (recall 18V-358)
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump and pipe
items.note: Free under recall 18V-358. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Seat belt may be held by the wrong bolts (recall 20V-811)
items.job: Replace seat belt mounting bolts
items.note: Free under recall 20V-811. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger seat hook weld may fail (recall 22V-375)
items.job: Inspect and replace passenger seat cushion frame
items.note: Free under recall 22V-375. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat belt buckle bolt may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and retorque front seat belt buckle bolt
items.note: Free under recall 24V-703. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Owner's manual may not load on the radio screen (recall)
items.job: Update radio software to load the electronic owner's manual
items.note: Free under recall 26V-114. Check the VIN first.
